text:
Elaine: Quick sketch for console IA — grouping left rail by workflow: Datasets | Models | Deployments. Intention: more stable deep links and clearer breadcrumbs. Sketch: https://www.figma.com/file/example/rail-ia
Sam: Uploaded a small prototype showing accordion groups + compact mode. https://www.figma.com/file/example/rail-compact
Priya: Agree with grouping but worried about density on narrow widths. Avoid double-scroll (rail + content).
Matt: Auto-collapse groups at <=1200px and use focus trap rules so keyboard only users can traverse groups. Arrow keys inside group, Enter/Space toggles.
DesignBot: A11y: add aria-expanded, aria-controls; when expanding move focus to first link; when collapsing return focus to toggle; show "Skip to main" on keyboard focus; announce rewrites to SRs.
Elaine: About legacy anchors: rewrite client-side from fragment to path (e.g. #predictions -> /predictions) using history.replaceState to avoid extra back entries. Show a one-time toast when rewriting.
Sam: Preserve query params (e.g. ?from_dashboard=1) during rewrite and log old->new mapping for telemetry.
Priya: Keep ephemeral overlays as query params (?overlay=compose) so ESC/back remain predictable.
Matt: Breadcrumbs: Workspace > App > Flow. Use slugs not internal IDs. On mobile collapse middle crumbs into overflow menu and expose full trail to screen readers via hidden list.
Elaine: Rollout: canary 10% of orgs. Add pptr tests for keyboard nav, focus order, skip link, and toast frequency.
Sam: Filing ticket PROD-rail-2101 and adding checklist to PR template.
Elaine: Decision: implement grouped rail + canonical fragment->path rewrites + responsive accordion + a11y focus rules + preserve query params. I'll draft spec and RFC.
DesignBot: Added accessibility checklist to the doc: focus order, aria attributes, skip link, SR announcements.
thread_summary: Design discussion about grouping sidebar by workflow, canonicalizing fragments to paths, responsive accordion behavior, accessibility requirements, and a canary rollout plan.
